title: Implement reviewed versioned production pipeline definitions
description: Implement spec section 14.0a: evidence-based proposals from repo/spec and recurring handoffs; versioned stage DAGs; one flow coordinator; specialist ownership; pinned artifact/check/resource contracts; separate taste approvals. Pipelines are optional and project-specific, not copied COMBATRIG stages. Agree ownership for any new src/pipelines surface before creating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Definition validation rejects cycles; unknown owners; ambiguous contracts; and duplicate authority
Creating or changing a definition requires reviewed owner approval
Ordinary projects without pipelines retain their existing task loop
